notes.title: Release 28/04/2023
notes.content:
[b][u]Save The Date 28/04/2023!!![/u][/b]

After 8 months of development, it's finally time to release Version 1.0 of The Unfound Soul.

[u][h1]Update[/h1][/u]

[h3]New[/h3]
[list]
[*] Character Level with Every Run
[/list]

[h3]Improvements[/h3]
[list]
[*] Improved Frame Rate
[*] There are too many Bug Fixes to list :>
[/list]

notes.title: Update 0.1.0 Last Update Before Release
notes.content:
[h3]New Features:[/h3]

[list]
[*] Artifacts now scale with your level, making them more powerful as you progress.
[*] The game now ends after you defeat the boss, giving you a clear objective to work towards.
[/list]

[h3]Bug Fixes:[/h3]

[list]
[*] Fixed an issue where players could get stuck in artifact combination, ensuring a smoother gameplay experience.
[/list]

[h2]Important Info:[/h2]

[b][u]Other than hotfixes, there will be no more updates until the release of Update 1.0.0.[/u][/b]

notes.title: Hotfix
notes.content: Fire Effect was showing for every unit

notes.title: Update 0.0.2
notes.content:
[h3][b][u]New features and changes[/u][/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] Enemy stats nerf
[*] Enemy scaling buff
[*] Display when hovering over attackable enemy
[*] Stat and effect information when hovering over a unit
[/list]

notes.title: Hotfix
notes.content: You can now heal at a campfire without being blocked.

notes.title: HotFix
notes.content:
[h1]Hotfix[/h1]

If a Charmed Enemy Kills Themselves, the Fight Continue.

notes.title: First Small Update
notes.content:
[h1][u]Update 0.0.1[/u][/h1]

[h3][u]Bug Fixes[/u][/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed issue where players could not enter the last level
[*] Fixed issue where options were not being saved and loaded properly
[*] Fixed alignment issue with tracks on top left in fights
[/list]

[h3][u]Added Functionality and Changes[/u][/h3]
[list]
[*] Reduces waiting time between effects playing
[*] Changed last fight to always be a boss fight
[*] Added simple boss fight
[*] Added new sound effects
[*] Removed decimal points from damage numbers
[*] Nerfed heal effect
[/list]

notes.title: short Hotfix
notes.content: Hotfix: Artifact combiner UI now scales according to screen size
